Researchers

literature via RAG; agent-driven
hypothesis / plan / execute

Configure profiles, build/manage
vector stores, run MCP servers,
deploy locally or as shared infra

span.p:
External AI Agents
Consume nml-mcp and
(optionally) RAG over HTTP / MCP

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Client UIs
Python (klea_agent.ui / klea_rag.ui)
Per-app NiceGUI pages + CLI wiring
Compose klea_utils UI components; CLI auto-spawns server, connects over HTTP/SSE

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
klea_agent
Python / FastAPI / LangGraph
General-purpose research agent (KleaAgent)
includes former code_pkg --- WIP
CLI: klea; serve: :8006

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
klea_rag
Python / FastAPI / LangGraph
Domain-configurable RAG pipeline (RAG)
CLI: klea-rag; serve: :8005 --- mature

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
nml-mcp (neuroml_mcp)
Python / FastMCP
NeuroML MCP server
CLI: nml-mcp --- streamable-http :8542

stdio subprocess per app; standalone via klea-mcp
